title: Late Fee Counted in a Card Catch-Up Charge: Storage Unit Figures under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
The late fee counted in the card catch-up charge on a storage unit agreement under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is the **maximum late fee** when the late-fee percentage of rent times the contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent, is above the maximum late fee; **that percentage amount** when it is above the flat late fee; and the **flat late fee** otherwise. The figures are those of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement's unit class:

| Unit class | Flat late fee | Maximum late fee | Late-fee percentage of rent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $55.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $60.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% |

**Three hypothetical tenants, input to output.**

- *Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault, contracted rent $280.00.* Ten percent is $28.00, not above the $30.00 flat fee: the late fee counted is **$30.00**.
- *Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault, contracted rent $310.00.* Ten percent is $31.00, above $30.00 and not above $75.00: **$31.00**.
- *Bluegate Climate Controlled, contracted rent $380.00.* Fifteen percent is $57.00, above the $55.00 maximum: **$55.00**.

**Edges.** A percentage amount exactly equal to the flat fee is not above it, so the flat fee is counted; one exactly equal to the maximum is not above it, so that amount (equal to the maximum) is counted. The percentage is taken of the contracted monthly rent, before any military discount.
